review_summary: The differential captures the dominant renal pathology and most high‑risk comorbidities, but probabilities were systematically undervalued and several important secondary diagnoses (CKD‑MBD, heart failure, transplant planning, NAFLD) were omitted or under‑emphasized. Critical laboratory gaps and lack of cardiac/vascular imaging limit definitive conclusions. Adjusted probabilities and added concerns provide a more accurate, actionable diagnostic hierarchy.
